summary: Georgia lookout list places a Dublin tower in Laurens County (GFC number 508); the Forest Lookouts page gives only the county; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: No source we checked says whether the tower still stands

evidence.supports: list row: Dublin tower in Laurens County at 32.49391, -82.93161, coded GA198, GFC number 508
the list's last column is headed GFC number
evidence.quote: GA tower list lat/lon, elevation, GFC number

evidence.supports: list page map revision stamp dated March 22, 2016
Forest Lookouts Dublin page gives only the name and Laurens County

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out against the list (county Laurens, GFC 508); no corrections. The list gives elevation 292 with no unit printed, so the story omits elevation rather than state feet. The Forest Lookouts Dublin page may carry photos that were not readable as text. Two WebSearch queries found only general Laurens County history and a 2010 registered antenna structure in Dublin (towerdex.com, blocked with a 403 when fetched), which is not a lookout by its listing. No source links a fire lookout to this site or describes its fate; the story says so only in the today paragraph. Worth a human look if a Georgia Forestry Commission records request is ever made.
